answer: A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, and hence it forfeits the pearl fee twice and still divides one payout. Because the river ledger attributes every share, the pulse audit publishes the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 47% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. That is 21 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
